exposure: pressurized metered-dose inhaler (pMDI) with valved holding chamber (VHC)
cohort: The study participants were children experiencing asthma exacerbations who were treated in a hospital.
finding: The analysis revealed that in a hospital setting, the cost of one-time short-acting b2-agonist (SABA) or SABA + short-acting muscarinic antagonist (SAMA) administration via pMDI+VHC is 1.5-2.4 times lower compared to nebulization (NEB).
